method: Read every repeated_adjacent_tuple_unresolved entry in findings.jsonl, parse its symbol/date key, join by date against explicit verified_closed rows in pinned canonical calendar and verified positive-open dates. No weekday inference. Closed/open sets disjoint.

classification.disposition: EXCLUDE_FROM_VALIDATED_CANDLES; preserve raw; no replacement inferred

limitations: Date-level classification only using pinned project evidence; no new independent provider verification, no row-level execution adjudication, no scanner integration or raw changes. Counts include all audited instrument classes, not only equities. Closed-session exclusions are recommended, not applied by this report.
